title: A Garden Under an Artificial Sky
fact_notes: オリジナル教材。一般的な考え方と架空例を用いた文章であり、実在の人物、調査、実験、法令、技術運用手順ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Growing plants in an enclosed environment requires people to consider processes that are ordinarily supported by the conditions of the surrounding landscape.
sentences.ja: 密閉環境で植物を育てるには、通常周囲の自然環境の条件が支える過程を考慮する必要がある。

sentences.en: Sunlight, the movement of air, and the availability of water contribute in different ways to the conditions under which a plant develops.
sentences.ja: 日光、空気の流れ、水の利用可能性は、植物が成長する条件に異なる形で寄与する。

sentences.en: An artificial environment may allow some of these conditions to be controlled, but controlling a single feature does not necessarily establish that the entire system is suitable for a particular species.
sentences.ja: 人工環境はこれらの条件の一部を制御可能にし得るが、単一の特徴の制御で全システムが特定種に適していると必ずしも確定しない。

sentences.en: These relationships become especially significant when an enclosed garden is imagined as part of a future settlement beyond Earth.
sentences.ja: これらの関係は密閉庭園を将来の地球外居住地の一部として想像すると特に重要になる。

sentences.en: In a fictional design exercise, a group proposes using plants to provide a regular supply of fresh food for the inhabitants of a small research station.
sentences.ja: 架空設計活動で集団は小研究所の住民へ新鮮な食料を定期的に供給するため植物を使う提案をする。

sentences.en: One designer initially suggests selecting the plants that produce the greatest amount of edible material within a given period.
sentences.ja: 一設計者は当初、一定期間内に最大量の食用部分を生む植物を選ぶことを提案する。

sentences.en: Another asks whether that measure adequately reflects the resources required to maintain the growing environment throughout the plant's life cycle.
sentences.ja: 別の者はその尺度が植物の生活環全体で栽培環境を維持するため必要な資源を十分反映するか尋ねる。

sentences.en: A crop that produces a desirable harvest may require conditions that are difficult to maintain alongside the other activities of the settlement.
sentences.ja: 望ましい収穫物を生む作物も居住地の他活動と並行して維持するのが難しい条件を要する場合がある。

sentences.en: The designers also consider the consequences of depending exclusively on a single kind of plant.
sentences.ja: 設計者は単一種類の植物だけに依存する影響も検討する。

sentences.en: A uniform collection may simplify certain aspects of scheduling and maintenance, whereas a more diverse collection could provide different opportunities and introduce additional challenges.
sentences.ja: 均一な植物群は日程管理・維持の一部側面を簡単にするかもしれず、より多様な群は異なる機会を提供し追加課題をもたらし得る。

sentences.en: Evaluating these alternatives would require information about the actual requirements and interactions of the selected species rather than an assumption that diversity automatically guarantees reliability.
sentences.ja: これらの選択肢の評価には多様性が自動的に信頼性を保証するという前提でなく選定種の実際の必要条件と相互作用についての情報が必要になる。

sentences.en: The imagined project consequently shifts its attention from selecting individual plants to examining the relationships among the components of the proposed garden.
sentences.ja: 仮想活動はそこで個別植物の選定から庭園案の構成要素間の関係の調査へ注意を移す。

sentences.en: The team prepares a description of the questions that would need to be addressed before a real system could be developed.
sentences.ja: チームは実システム開発前に扱う必要がある問いの記述を用意する。

sentences.en: It distinguishes demands that are expected to remain relatively stable from those that might vary during different stages of growth.
sentences.ja: 比較的安定すると予想される需要と異なる生長段階で変動するかもしれない需要を区別する。

sentences.en: The designers acknowledge that genuine experiments and detailed engineering assessments would be indispensable for determining whether any actual proposal was safe and effective.
sentences.ja: 実際の提案が安全・有効か決定するには本物の実験と詳細な工学評価が不可欠であると認める。

sentences.en: Their work is a thought experiment about the scope of a design problem rather than a verified plan for producing food in space.
sentences.ja: 作業は宇宙での食料生産の検証済み計画でなく設計問題の範囲に関する思考実験だ。

sentences.en: An artificial garden can make the dependence of living organisms on their surroundings unusually apparent.
sentences.ja: 人工庭園は生物の周囲環境への依存を非常に明白にし得る。

sentences.en: A practical design must account not only for the product that people hope to obtain but also for the conditions that make its production possible over time.
sentences.ja: 実用的設計は得たい産物だけでなく、時間を通じて生産を可能にする条件も考慮しなければならない。

sentences.en: The question of how to grow plants beyond Earth thus invites reflection on the interconnected processes that support agriculture within familiar environments.
sentences.ja: 地球外でどう植物を育てるかという問いは、身近な環境で農業を支える相互接続した過程についての熟考を促す。

sentences.en: The artificial sky makes some ordinary relationships easier to notice.
sentences.ja: 人工の空は一部の普通の関係に気づきやすくする。

questions.prompt: Why does control of one condition not ensure suitability?
options: All species require exactly the same conditions.
Natural processes cannot occur in enclosed spaces.
Every artificial system has unlimited resources.
A plant depends on multiple interacting environmental conditions.
questions.explanation_ja: 複数の条件が関係する。

questions.prompt: Which processes or resources are mentioned?
options: Sunlight, air movement and water availability.
Only the size of the station.

questions.prompt: What measure does one designer initially suggest?
options: Amount of edible material produced within a period.
Number of researchers at the station.
questions.explanation_ja: 一定期間の食用部分の生産量。

options: An edible crop necessarily needs no maintenance.
The harvest always determines every resource requirement.
It may not reflect the resources needed throughout growth.
The team has no interest in supplying food.
questions.explanation_ja: 維持資源が反映されない可能性。

questions.prompt: What benefit might a uniform collection offer?
Why avoid assuming that diversity guarantees reliability?
options: The garden should contain no plants.
Actual species requirements and interactions need evaluation.
questions.explanation_ja: 実際の相互作用の評価。

questions.prompt: What is required to evaluate a real system?
options: A list of attractive plants only.

questions.prompt: Why distinguish stable and changing demands?
options: Resources may be required differently during growth stages.
All demands are fixed throughout every plant's life.
The selection of plants has no practical consequences.
No plant changes as it grows.

questions.prompt: Which statement captures the main argument?
options: The crop with the largest harvest is necessarily best.
Growing plants beyond Earth requires no experimentation.
Growing plants in artificial environments requires examining the system that sustains production, not merely its yield.
All plants can survive under any controlled condition.
questions.explanation_ja: 生産を支えるシステム全体。
